users_select.name: users_select
users_select.using:
app_is_system()
        OR "users"."id" = app_current_user()
        OR "users"."id" IN (
          SELECT m.user_id FROM memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = app_current_org()
        )

memberships_select.name: memberships_select
memberships_select.using:
app_is_system()
        OR "memberships"."organization_id" = app_current_org()
        OR (app_current_org() IS NULL AND "memberships"."user_id" = app_current_user())

organizations_select.name: organizations_select
organizations_select.using:
app_is_system()
        OR "organizations"."id" = app_current_org()
        OR (app_current_org() IS NULL AND "organizations"."id" IN (
          SELECT m.organization_id FROM memberships m
          WHERE m.user_id = app_current_user() AND m.status = 'active'
        ))

roles_system_consistency_check.name: roles_system_consistency_check
roles_system_consistency_check.value: ("roles"."is_system" and "roles"."system_key" is not null) or (not "roles"."is_system" and "roles"."system_key" is null)

generated.as: to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(name, '') || ' ' || coalesce(domain, '') || ' ' || coalesce(phone, '') || ' ' || coalesce(industry, '') || ' ' || coalesce(city, ''))

crm_companies_org_domain_unique.name: crm_companies_org_domain_unique
crm_companies_org_domain_unique.where: "crm_companies"."domain" is not null and "crm_companies"."deleted_at" is null

generated.as: to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(first_name, '') || ' ' || coalesce(last_name, '') || ' ' || coalesce(email, '') || ' ' || coalesce(phone, '') || ' ' || coalesce(whatsapp_phone, '') || ' ' || coalesce(job_title, ''))

crm_contacts_org_email_unique.name: crm_contacts_org_email_unique
crm_contacts_org_email_unique.where: "crm_contacts"."email" is not null and "crm_contacts"."deleted_at" is null

calendar_availability_exceptions_minutes.name: calendar_availability_exceptions_minutes_check
calendar_availability_exceptions_minutes.value: ("calendar_availability_exceptions"."start_minute" is null and "calendar_availability_exceptions"."end_minute" is null) or ("calendar_availability_exceptions"."start_minute" >= 0 and "calendar_availability_exceptions"."end_minute" <= 1440 and "calendar_availability_exceptions"."start_minute" < "calendar_availability_exceptions"."end_minute")

commerce_invoices_issued_check.name: commerce_invoices_issued_check
commerce_invoices_issued_check.value: "commerce_invoices"."status" = 'draft' or ("commerce_invoices"."number" is not null and "commerce_invoices"."issue_date" is not null)
